modalLead: One set of keys for every view, a strip that says what your keys do, tags and your own commands in the search panel, and three holiday themes.

items.text: One set of keys for every view. With the cursor on a bookmark, plain letters act on it: e edits, m moves, t tags, p pins, q shows a QR code. Shift plus a letter opens a view, and ? opens keys and help for the page you are on, with first steps you can try.
items.title: One set of keys for every view

media.alt: An arrow key puts the cursor on a bookmark, then ? opens Keys and help on This page, with the first steps and their Try it buttons

items.text: A strip says what your keys do. Beside the page name it says Search, Cursor or Edit mode, suggests keys for the row you are on, and fades after two seconds. Every view also has a key legend. Shift+S switches the strip, Shift+H the legend.
items.title: A strip says what your keys do

media.alt: The mode strip beside the page name changes from Search to Cursor and suggests other letters as the cursor moves down a category

items.text: Many keys moved. The Bookmarks view is Shift+B, Containers Shift+C, edit mode Shift+E, Config ,, finders ! and the news Shift+W. For a while an old key still works and tells you which key replaced it.
Menus read the right key aloud. A screen reader names the plain letter of a row action, not Shift plus that letter.

Search by tag, and your commands first. # opens the panel on your tags, and docker AND linux OR network joins them. : opens on the commands, with the ones you ran lately and the ones you use most at the top.
items.title: Search by tag, and your commands first

media.alt: The search panel opened with #: typing linux AND security narrows the bookmarks to those with both tags, then : lists the commands with Recent and Most used on top

items.text: The mode is a badge. The :, ! or # you typed sits in front of the field instead of in your words, and Backspace on an empty field goes back to plain search.

Three holiday themes. Christmas Classic, Northern Lights and Gingerbread Village, in light and dark, with a tree, a forest or a village behind your cards and snow or sprinkles falling in front. They stand still when you turn motion down. Find them under Holidays in the theme studio.
Reading one item no longer rings as news. Opening a single news item made the bell think new news had come in.
A row that comes back rings again. When something the bell had put away returned, it now rings, even with a smaller count than before.
Two tips about the key help. The bell explains the mode strip a minute into your visit, and the key legend three days later.
Add Bookmark in the Bookmarks view. The button sits in the view's band, left of Work through.
A Support card on Config → Overview. A coffee on Ko-fi, if nextDash earns its place on your screen.
